project_type: Monorepo: React 18.3 + Vite 5.4 frontend (plain JSX, no TypeScript) at repo root; NEW ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) Minimal API backend to be created under server/. Data layer is Supabase (Postgres + RLS + Auth), already provisioned (Phase A migrations) and wired into the frontend (Phase B/B2).
language: C# (net10.0) for the backend; JavaScript/JSX for the frontend.
build_system: Backend: dotnet CLI / MSBuild, solution server/FoodHerons.sln. Frontend: Vite (npm). .NET SDK 10.0.401 is installed and confirmed. Node v24.
test_framework: Backend: xUnit (server/FoodHerons.Api.Tests). Frontend: NONE (package.json has only dev/build/preview scripts) — frontend verification is `npm run build`.
build_command: Backend: `dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln`. Frontend: `npm run build` (run from the worktree root).
test_command: Backend: `dotnet test server/FoodHerons.sln`. Frontend: no tests; `npm run build` must pass.
verification_instructions: Per design §7 Phase C: (1) `dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln` succeeds; (2) `dotnet test server/FoodHerons.sln` passes (OrderService total computation, Asia/Manila openness incl. overnight-wrap, transition state machine, input validation); (3) `npm run build` succeeds after frontend wiring; (4) secret-leak check: no real connection string / JWT secret / service-role key in any tracked file (placeholders only), and `git status` shows no .env / bin/ / obj/ staged; (5) confirm no client-side direct write to orders/order_items was introduced in src/.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. The backend build produces server/**/bin and server/**/obj which must be git-ignored, not committed. Frontend `dist/` is already git-ignored.
environment_constraints: Windows, PowerShell. Work ONLY inside the worktree c:\\Users\\paulc\\Projects\\FoodHerons\\.worktrees\\phase-c-order-service on branch phase-c-order-service — relative paths resolve there, NOT the parent workspace. Do NOT modify any SQL under supabase/. The service must BUILD and TEST with NO live Supabase secret (secrets come from dotnet user-secrets in dev / env vars in prod at runtime). Service dev URL/port is http://localhost:5080. Commit locally on the branch; NEVER push.
contribution_requirements: No secrets committed anywhere (design §6). appsettings.json holds NON-secret config only (Supabase:Url, Issuer, Audience, empty ConnectionStrings placeholder). appsettings.Development.json has placeholders only and IS committed. Secrets via dotnet user-secrets / env vars: ConnectionStrings__Postgres, Supabase__JwtSecret (HS256) and/or JWKS (derived from Url), optional Supabase__ServiceRoleKey. Commit server/FoodHerons.Api/.env.example with placeholder keys only. Update root .gitignore to cover server/**/bin/, server/**/obj/, server/**/.env with a `!server/FoodHerons.Api/.env.example` negation placed AFTER the .env.* line. Money is numeric(10,2) -> use C# decimal end to end (never double/float).
key_patterns: Supabase access token for the Authorization: Bearer header comes from supabase.auth.getSession() -> data.session.access_token (the singleton client is src/lib/supabase.js; AuthContext does NOT expose the token). Frontend base URL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api' (already set to /api in .env.example). JWT validation (design §4): JwtBearer, default JWKS mode at ${Supabase:Url}/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json, HS256 fallback when Supabase:JwtSecret is set; issuer ${Supabase:Url}/auth/v1, audience 'authenticated'; read sub (user id) + app_metadata.role. order_code is assigned by the orders.code column DEFAULT ('FH-'||lpad(nextval('public.order_code_seq')::text,6,'0')) — INSERT omits code and uses RETURNING. Service connects with the service-role Postgres connection (Npgsql) and bypasses RLS. OrderService must keep pure logic (price/total, Manila openness, state machine) behind test-stubbable abstractions so xUnit runs with no live DB. Asia/Manila is a FIXED UTC+8 offset (no DST) — do not depend on a Windows tz database id.
